name: Tool — Work IQ (1P MCP)
summary: Microsoft 1P MCP server: Work IQ (Microsoft Graph / work context).
description: Work IQ is exposed as an MCP-style tool that can provide Microsoft work data, such as email context, to a Prompt Agent while the host orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This covers workplace grounding scenarios through a gateway-backed agent.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry because `WORK_IQ_MCP_URL` is not configured in the canary environment. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/work-iq. See `test.py`.

Work IQ is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list; only Foundry IQ is listed among the 1P MCP servers. Official list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations.
